learning_outcomes: Count objects 1 to 20 forward and backward

lessons.subject: Mathematics
lessons.topic: Counting Objects up to 20 with Counting Sticks
lessons.parent_script: Hold up a bundle of 10 matchsticks: How many do we have in this bundle? Let us add 5 more!
lessons.learning_objective: Count and group concrete objects up to 20 without skipping.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Count 10 sticks and bundle.
2. Add single sticks to make 11-19.
3. Match with numeral flashcards.

lessons.subject: English Literacy
lessons.parent_script: Make the snake sound /ssss/ and ask: What fruit starts with /a/? Yes, an apple!
lessons.learning_objective: Pronounce initial phonetic sounds and identify corresponding letters.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Trace letters s, a, t, p in sand.
2. Blend simple CVC words: sat, pat, tap.
3. Read 3 sentences aloud.

lessons.subject: Environmental Activities
lessons.parent_script: Look around our kitchen: How do we help keep our plates and cups clean after meals?
lessons.learning_objective: Identify safe kitchen cleaning procedures and safety with breakables.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Practice washing plastic cups safely.
2. Rinse in clean water and place on rack.
3. Draw clean utensils in workbook.
